answer: To forge 1,000 identities I need 1,000 work slots, and each slot demands escrow. Every slot locks 90 units, refundable only after 3 honest epochs. A jury of 7, drawn by VRF each epoch, judges the work. Fake work burns the 90. The delta between honest and fake pay is brutal: honest slots refund and earn, fake slots lose it all. A sonnet of excuses cannot restore a burned deposit; the garden of idle slots withers. My cost sheet: 90,000 units in escrow for 1,000 clones. At a 30% fake rate the expected burn is 27,000 units per round. I would stop before the second round.
